title: Searching narrows the list, Enter moves nobody, no match says so
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop's own term is held by three customers, and you search for one of them in Move Customers.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 15 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly three customers, {Customer-A}, {Customer-B} and {Customer-C} (a new term holds only this case's customers), whose names are in that A to Z order, with credit limits of $500.00, $0.00 and $1,000.00.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-04 N15, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-04 Alpha, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-04 Bravo and {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-04 Charlie.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Type the last word of {Customer-B}'s name in lower-case letters in "Search customers".
  4. Press Enter.
  5. Replace the search text with "qqqq".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens.
  • Step 3: only {Customer-B} is listed (the match ignores capitals).
  • Step 4: nothing is moved: the window stays open and no toast shows.
  • Step 5: the list area shows "No customers match your search."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R5: “Typing in the search box narrows the list to customers whose name contains the text, ignoring capitals. Pressing Enter in the search box does not move anyone. When nothing matches, the list area shows "No customers match your search."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Move Customers search has no match | "No customers match your search." | Inline line in the list area”
